data_description.update_interval: How often to poll the fastest-changing data — battery, climate and doors/windows (60-1800 seconds). Location and the odometer are polled 3x less often, status and charging settings 8x, and software and schedules 30x.
data_description.enable_streams: Keeps live subscriptions open for battery, climate, exterior and location so changes appear within seconds instead of on the next poll. Off by default: polling alone keeps everything up to date, and persistent subscriptions are the least predictable part of the unofficial API.

init.description: Polling is tiered — each kind of data refreshes at a rate matched to how often it actually changes. Lower intervals mean fresher data but more requests to Polestar's servers and more 12V battery use.
